title: eriophorum cyperinum var. brachypodum
intro: Eriophorum cyperinum var. brachypodum, commonly known as Cotton Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family, Cyperaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting expectoration. The therapeutic actions of Cotton Grass include its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, making it an effective treatment for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Cotton Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
